title: DesignatedShelter
description: One designated shelter (指定避難所, Basic Act on Disaster Management Art. 49-7), the master record of a place where evacuees stay: as municipalities register it and GSI publishes it. Its operation during a disaster (opening status, evacuee counts) is EvacuationShelter, which links here with shelter

name.description: Name of the shelter (the facility's name)

externalShelterId.description: The shelter's ID in the municipality's own shelter list (unique within the municipality). Required unless nationalShelterId is given

nationalShelterId.description: 全国共通避難所・避難場所ID (GSI 共通ID): fixed 'E' + 5-digit municipality code + 5-digit facility code + type code (1 = designated shelter; then 1 = general, 2 = welfare) + 1 alphanumeric sequence starting at 1. Required unless externalShelterId is given

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code of the municipality that designates the shelter (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits)

shelterType.description: general (一般避難所) or welfare (福祉避難所, for people who need special care); the second type digit of nationalShelterId says the same

address.description: Address of the shelter, as a JapaneseAddress value (common subject)

location.description: Where the shelter is, as a point

maxCapacity.description: Number of people the shelter is planned to hold

targetEvacuees.description: Who the shelter is for, in the municipality's words (受入対象者), e.g. for a welfare shelter

alsoEmergencyEvacuationSite.description: true when a designated emergency evacuation site has the same address (指定緊急避難場所との住所同一)

site.description: The designated emergency evacuation site (EvacuationSite) at the same place

designationNotes.description: Other matters the mayor considers necessary (その他市町村長が必要と認める事項)
